models.currentStaff: The signed-in EduBridge staff member using the portal. Every staff member has the same access.
models.today: The current date in Africa/Lagos, used to work out due, overdue and closing-soon items.
models.companies: Client companies that EduBridge recruits for. Staff pick one when creating a job, or add a new one inline.
models.jobs: Every job staff have created, in any status: draft, published, paused or closed. Closed jobs record whether the role was filled or cancelled.
models.applications: A candidate's application to a job, with their CV, cover letter, screening answers, current stage, review targets and a dated history of every stage change.
models.enquiries: Messages sent through the public Contact and For Employers forms, with a follow-up status and internal staff notes.
models.stageEmailTemplates: The candidate email sent for each stage staff can set, shown as a preview in the stage change dialog. Placeholders in curly braces are filled in per candidate.
models.formOptions: Choices for the job form, company form and filters.
models.weeklyActivity: Applications received and candidates moved to interview in each of the last eight weeks (week starting Monday), for the Overview chart.

relationships: Each job belongs to one company (companyId); a company can have many jobs or none
Each application belongs to one job (jobId); applicant counts per job are worked out from applications
Each application's answers refer to the screening questions on its job
Each application has a history of stage changes, newest last
Enquiries stand alone; For Employers enquiries carry extra employer details
